== Reorganization, 25 November 2026 ==
The working list was regrouped by year (newest first), with a subsection for each event. All 438 rows were kept. Clue cells that used “X is not Y” wording were rewritten to describe the unlabeled people and, where relevant, who is already named. A short “How to help” section was added, with links to [[Mysteries]] and [[Unknown players]]. The category is now [[:Category:SWCCG Wiki]] (the former Category:Wiki does not exist).
